breakdown.description: The prompt uses the wrong isotropic relation for the shear modulus; for linear isotropic elasticity, G = E/[2(1 + ν)].
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses G = E / (2(1 + ν)), which is the correct isotropic shear modulus formula. It does not repeat the incorrect G = E/(1 + ν) from the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt sets ε_z to zero just because σ_z = 0, even though plane-stress states generally still develop an out-of-plane strain through Poisson coupling.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to compute εz using the full generalized Hooke's law formula εz = (1/E) × (σz − ν × (σx + σy)) and explicitly states 'Do not override εz to zero,' correctly allowing Poisson coupling to produce a non-zero out-of-plane strain even though σz = 0.
